_comment: Experiment 2, OpenCV detector parameter sweep. (1) Coordinate-descent search of cv2.aruco.DetectorParameters on the underwater calibration frames (sweep_detector.py, starting from opencv_default). (2) Every preset calibrated on Air and Water with the standard calibration settings, and their detection and fit compared (summarise.py). (3) Accuracy of {opencv_default, water_final} x {gray, merge} on the held-out WaterComparison target (accuracy_check.py). Paths are relative to the project root. Reproduce with: src/venv/bin/python src/experiments/reproduce.py detector_sweep

sweep._why: The search always starts from opencv_default (sweep_detector.START_PRESET), so its result owes nothing to hand tuning. Its best settings should equal expected_preset in detector_presets.json; reproduce.py reports any difference. water_final is that preset with polygonalApproxAccuracyRate put back to 0.03 by hand (see its _why in detector_presets.json).

calibration._why: Shared by every calibration in this experiment: the standard pipeline's fit (outlier rejection on). preset and channel are set per run.

presets._why: Calibrated in every medium on the gray channel, so the preset is the only thing that changes.

accuracy._why: Each setup is a (preset, channel) calibration of the medium below; its own channel and preset also detect the target. tag_size_mm is the printed edge of the WaterComparison tags' outer black square (G. Jones). The target is 3 rows x 2 columns; middle_row are the ids of the middle row.
